description: Refactor step M11a, class B (docs/plans/codebase-refactor.md §6.5): the entries of Tools() in internal/mcp/tools.go move into per-area constructors of at most 100 lines each, in tools_<area>.go, and Tools() concatenates them in today's order. Preview with: go run ./internal/tools/splittools -n -spec internal/tools/splittools/specs/M11a.json

constructors.doc: // projectTools returns the project tools, in Tools() order.

// artifactReadTools returns the tools that list a project's artifacts and
// read one, in Tools() order.

// artifactOverviewTools returns the tools that read a project's artifacts
// as a map or a tree, or one artifact with its context, in Tools() order.
// artifactSearchTools returns the artifact search tool.
// artifactCreateTools returns the artifact create tool.
// artifactUpdateTools returns the artifact update tool.
// linkTools returns the trace link tools, in Tools() order.
// baselineTools returns the baseline tools, in Tools() order.
// reviewTools returns the review round tool.
// testRunTools returns the test run tools, in Tools() order.
// qualityTools returns the requirement quality tools, in Tools() order.

// vvTools returns the verification coverage and gap tools, in Tools()
// order.
// workItemListTools returns the tool that lists a project's work items.

// workItemTools returns the tools that read and update one work item, in
// Tools() order.
